title: Normalization Protocol for Genomic and Proteomic Applications
author: Opentrons
materials: Create your CSV file according to our instructions.
Make sure to add reagents to your labware before placing it on the deck! Your diluent should be in your reservoir, and the samples you’re normalizing should be in your plate.

steps.title: Gather required equipment
steps.instruction: Collect the following items: Opentrons OT‑2 robot, Opentrons OT‑2 Run App (Version 3.15.0 or later), a single‑channel pipette with compatible tips, a 96‑well or 384‑well plate containing samples, an automation‑friendly reservoir, diluent, and any additional labware listed in the Opentrons Labware Library.

steps.title: Prepare CSV file
steps.instruction: Create a comma‑separated value (.csv) file that lists the volume to add to each well in microliters (μL). The file must be saved as .csv, formatted in landscape orientation, with the value for well A1 in the upper‑left corner. Example: 40 μL for A1, 41 μL for B1, etc. You may copy the provided template spreadsheet, fill in your volumes, and export as CSV. Note: All values corresponding to wells in the CSV must ha (as stated in the original note).

substeps.instruction: Enter volumes (μL) for each well, starting with A1 in the top‑left cell.
Save the file in .csv format (or export from the template spreadsheet).

steps.title: Upload CSV and configure settings
steps.instruction: In the normalization protocol generator, upload your CSV file and select all desired settings according to the “Setup” section to customize the OT‑2 run.

steps.title: Download generated protocol
steps.instruction: Click the blue “Download” button located above the deckmap to download the customized OT‑2 protocol file.

steps.title: Load protocol into Opentrons App and run
steps.instruction: Upload the downloaded protocol into the Opentrons App, follow the on‑screen instructions to set up the deck with the listed labware, calibrate the labware, and start the run.
